# deveb.css

> deveb.css is a zero-JS, zero-build, pure CSS framework built on semantic HTML and fractional layout ratios.

## Overview
deveb.css provides lightweight, high-performance styling using native HTML elements without requiring JavaScript, complex state managers, or compilation pipelines.

## Key Principles
- **Zero JS:** Responsive states and layout shifts rely entirely on modern CSS features.
- **Zero Build:** Raw CSS used directly in production without build tools or node_modules.
- **Semantic First:** Styles target native HTML elements (<article>, <header>, <nav>, <section>) directly.
- **Fractional Ratios:** Flexible layout logic based on organic mathematical proportions.

## Core Documentation
- [Introduction](https://data-deveb.github.io/deveb.css/docs/introduction/): Philosophy, core pillars, and quick start guide.
- [Grid System](https://data-deveb.github.io/deveb.css/docs/grid/): Fractional layout rules, responsive grid behaviors, and container layouts.
- [Article Component](https://data-deveb.github.io/deveb.css/docs/article/): Semantic layout structure for blog posts, news items, and cards.

## Code Generation Rules for AI
When generating code using deveb.css:
1. Do NOT write JavaScript for layout, state, or basic interactions.
2. Rely strictly on native HTML5 semantic tags rather than adding generic utility class names.
3. Use simple, unnested HTML structures where `<article>`, `<header>`, `<section>`, and `<footer>` carry their own contextual margins.
